## Mission: repair the build (attempt 1 of 3)

### What failed

`tsc --noEmit` failed:

```
src/journeys.test.tsx(49,12): error TS2304: Cannot find name 'row'.
```

### Focus

TypeScript errors from `tsc --noEmit`, fix exactly these:
src/journeys.test.tsx(49,12): error TS2304: Cannot find name 'row'.

### The contract you must not break

`src/app-config.ts` must render these exact strings, and `src/journeys.test.tsx` must query the same ones:

- Form labels (what `addRecord`/`editRecord` fill): Title, Author, Category
- To test an empty required field, blank the required TEXT field "Title" (`addRecord(user, { "Title": "" })`) and assert "Title: Title is required.". Never pass "" for a select, date or number field -- omit the key to keep its initial value.
- Never on the form, only an action sets them: Borrower
- "Category" options: Novel, Cookbook, Reference
- Validation message for "Title": "Title is required" — it also appears in the form's problem summary as "Title: Title is required", so assert that exact string, never a regex
- Validation message for "Author": "Author is required" — it also appears in the form's problem summary as "Author: Author is required", so assert that exact string, never a regex
- Validation message for "Category": "Category is required" — it also appears in the form's problem summary as "Category: Category is required", so assert that exact string, never a regex
- Filter chip "Lent out" (borrower is not empty)
- Filter chips for "Category": "By category" plus one chip per option above
- Every filter chip reads "<label> (count)", e.g. "Lent out (2)"; `chooseFilter` matches by prefix, so pass the plain label and never an anchored regex. "By category" is the chip that clears every filter.
- Badge text "Lent to {borrower}" when borrower is not empty — substitute the row's own value for each {name}: with borrower = "Sam" the row reads "Lent to Sam"
- Stat tile "Lent out" = count of rows where borrower is not empty — read it with `stat("Lent out")`, which returns a string
- Row button "Lend", asks for "Borrower name", toast "Book lent" — shown only when borrower is empty
- Row button "Return", toast "Book returned" — shown only when borrower is not empty
- Header "Home Library", add button "Add book", empty state "No books yet" / "Add your first book with the form."
- Rows are sorted by "Title" ascending, so `rowTitles()` returns them alphabetically, not in the order you added them.
- Scaffold behaviour you never configure: delete is one click plus a "<title> deleted." toast with an "Undo" button — `removeRecord` clicks Delete and confirms any dialog itself, so never call `confirmDialog` after it; `reload()` keeps the stored records but resets the search box and the active filter; corrupt storage shows a "could not be read" notice.
- Never query a badge, stat or chip string with `screen.getByText`/`getAllByText`: the same words can sit on a badge, a stat tile and a chip at once. Assert a badge with `expectRow(title, text)`, a stat with `stat(label)`, a chip with `await chooseFilter(user, label)`, a toast or validation message with `screen.getByText(exact string)`.

### Likely culprit

src/journeys.test.tsx — the file each error names. Fix the types; do not silence them with `any` or `@ts-ignore`.

### How to fix it

- Read only the file you are going to edit, then make the smallest edit that fixes the failure above. Change nothing else -- no refactors, no renames, no new files.
- Never edit src/lib/, src/components/, src/App.tsx, src/test/, src/styles.css, vitest.config.ts, package.json.
- Do not run any command: the harness runs `tsc` and `vitest` after your turn.
- End your turn immediately after the edit, with no summary.
